# 湛箴_ymzz

> 深淵的清澈的水，纂刻于竹篾上的痕，珍重微小，有所依據，立傳傳世

- Official site: https://ya-mic.github.io/ymzz/
- Source: https://github.com/Ya-MiC/ymzz (branch: master)
- Brand: 晏銘湛箴 / Ya-MiC
- Product: a local-first AI agent distribution built on the full official DeepSeek Harness ("everything is a plugin"). It is not a DeepSeek official product. It is not 稟冊.

## Honest status

There is no accepted public installer for 湛箴_ymzz yet. Windows packages are pending release and acceptance. macOS and Linux desktop packages are planned and not guaranteed. The truthful current entry is running from source (see https://ya-mic.github.io/ymzz/start.html). Do not describe draft or private installers from other repositories as this product.

The tagging panel and the local knowledge ledger are implemented in the source tree (`packages/ymzz/product`) and unit-tested. They are not yet accepted on a real Windows GUI, and no installer ships them. v1 does not sync anything to a cloud account; treat any claim of cloud sync as false for this version.

## Tagging panel (what it actually does)

1. Entries: session, message, visible reasoning text, web page, local file, artifact, note, task.
2. Tags are many-to-many and user-owned; Lists assemble entries across sessions, in the spirit of GitHub Stars and Lists.
3. The nebula view groups entries by top-level tag into at most eight clusters; one entry may belong to several clusters.
4. Nothing is captured automatically: no browser history read, no whole-disk scan, no cloud upload.
5. Approved notes are written as Obsidian-compatible Markdown (YAML frontmatter, `[[wiki links]]`) into the Vault the user selects. Every Vault write requires explicit human approval and can be revoked.
6. Delivered so far: the ledger, the approval flow and the registry data model. The browser extension and cloud sync are planned, not shipped.

## Desktop shell (planned, not shipped)

The desktop build is a Rust + Tauri 2 shell around the unmodified DSH runtime. One installer is intended to bundle three parts: the DSH runtime, Dashi Taskboard (Apache-2.0, https://github.com/chuspeeism/dashi-taskboard) and T3 Code (MIT, https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code). The shell owns window, install, update and lifecycle only. GitHub Actions is planned to track upstream releases and cut a daily canary plus a version manifest consumed by this site; until those artifacts exist, no download button is shown.

## Privacy

No tracking cookies, no analytics scripts, no third-party font CDNs. Language and theme preferences are stored in the browser only after the visitor allows it. See https://ya-mic.github.io/ymzz/privacy.html.

## Preserved sibling product (not this agent)

稟冊 is a separate Tauri local-first personal work-report / file-management app. Files, AI conversation records, review progress, and nickname onboarding stay on the user's computer. Keep these links, and do not merge the products:

- https://ya-mic.github.io/ymzz-loop/
